audit.whatIsWrong: Chart reads [Sylas, Sylas, Skill, Skill, Skill, Skill, Skill] on both layers. Packet levelChart is [Skill, Mordekaiser, Mordekaiser, Skill, Mordekaiser, Sylas, Sylas] and the page's own whys line up with the packet row for row: whys[0] 'it's a wash', whys[1] 'you out-trade', whys[2] 'you out-sustain his level-3 Kingslayer', whys[3] 'Trades even out', whys[4] Realm banish, whys[5] 'no longer your free win', whys[6] 'out-scales you'.
audit.why: Sylas has no level-1 threat and his sustain does not exist until Kingslayer is leveled, so 2-3 belong to Mordekaiser; from his first AP item onward Kingslayer's heal out-refuels the Indestructible bank and Abscond-Abduct kites a dashless melee.
audit.corrected: Level 1 Skill, Level 2 Mordekaiser, Level 3 Mordekaiser, Levels 4-5 Skill, Level 6 Mordekaiser, First item Sylas, 2+ items Sylas. Matched pairs with ratings.

audit.why: Four spikes present and real: Lvl 2-3 window, Lvl 6 Realm of Death, 1st AP item, Late full-AP Sylas.

audit.whatIsWrong: Abscond / Abduct is described as 'His dash + stun (recast pull)' in breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and report[5].t, and wants.foe[0] calls it an 'Abduct stun'. Riot's text says nothing about a stun: 'Sylas dashes to a location. Sylas can recast the ability to throw his chains out, pulling himself to an enemy he hits.' The recast pulls SYLAS to you — it is a gap-closer, not lockdown. Kingslayer's heal is also never tied to anti-heal anywhere on the page.
audit.why: A player told the E stuns will hold back the engage waiting for CC that never comes, and will misread the recast as something aimed at them rather than a commitment by Sylas that puts him inside Obliterate range. The Kingslayer heal is what actually loses the long trade, and Grievous Wounds is the answer.
audit.corrected: Abscond: 400-range dash, 13/12/11/10/9s, recast (Abduct) chains Sylas to an enemy he hits — no stun. Kingslayer: 400 range on 12/10.5/9/7.5/6s, heals him against champions — hold Grievous Wounds for extended trades. Chain Lash 775 range, 10-6s, slows. Hijack is 80/55/30s and can take your Realm of Death.

notes: The substantive correction is that Abscond / Abduct does not stun. Four separate fields told the reader to wait out a stun that does not exist, and wants.foe[0] named it directly; Riot's text has the recast pull Sylas to the target, which is the opposite read for positioning. The _missing entry (Kingslayer sustain needing Grievous Wounds) now lands in dontsFull[2]. Chart flipped to the packet, which the page's own whys already agreed with on all seven rows. Recurring kit bug, unchanged: Obliterate carries a grounding flag Riot's description does not support — notable here because Sylas has two dashes and a grounding Q would be a genuine matchup-defining interaction if it were real. Worth a human ruling before any agent writes it.
